editorial.blurb: A polished Korean BBQ spot where high-quality meat and attentive service shine, though you'll cook your own meat—research the style beforehand.
editorial.insiderTip: Visit during slower hours if you want staff to cook for you; otherwise, come prepared to grill yourself. The Jin Soo Sung Chan set menu ($49.95pp, 3-person minimum) offers excellent value with multiple meat cuts and sides.
signatureDishes: Jin Soo Sung Chan set menu
